Outcome: Elevated NLR could predict lymph node involvement.
NLR was significantly higher in patients with non-localized TGCT compared to those with localized TGCT.
Elevated NLR could predict the presence of nodal or distant metastases.
High levels of NLR were associated with metastasis and poorer CSS.
There was no significant association between metastasis with NLR of patients.
No significant correlation was found between metastasis with NLR.
NLR had no statistically significant correlation with metastasis and the presence of lymphovascular invasion.
There was no significant association between NLR and metastasis or lymph node involvement.
